Check detailed price lists.  Sounak Mukhopadhyay Published 21 Oct 2026, 07:41 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Fuel prices today: Check petrol, diesel and CNG rates on 21 October in different cities across India (Sunil Ghosh/HT PHOTO) ( Sunil Ghosh/HT PHOTO ) AI Quick Read Fuel prices remained unchanged across most listed cities today, 21 October. However, Noida recorded small increases in petrol and diesel prices. CNG prices rose in nine locations, with increases ranging from 50 paise to ₹ 2. Chennai, Mathura and Meerut recorded the biggest CNG increases, at ₹ 2 each. Petrol and diesel prices today In New Delhi, petrol stood at ₹ 102.12 while diesel cost ₹ 95.20. Mumbai recorded petrol at ₹ 111.21 and diesel at ₹ 97.83. Kolkata’s petrol price was ₹ 113.51 while diesel stood at ₹ 99.82. Chennai recorded petrol at ₹ 107.76 and diesel at ₹ 99.55. Both fuel prices remained unchanged across these four cities today. Kolkata’s petrol price was ₹ 2.30 higher than Mumbai’s petrol price. Chennai’s diesel price was ₹ 1.72 higher than Mumbai’s diesel price. Also Read | E20 fuel debate: Former HPCL chief says ethanol blend won’t cut petrol prices Noida’s petrol price increased by 16 paise to ₹ 102.12. Diesel rose by 12 paise to ₹ 95.56 in the city. Petrol prices in Noida and New Delhi were therefore equal. However, Noida’s diesel price was 36 paise higher than New Delhi’s. Gurgaon recorded unchanged petrol and diesel prices of ₹ 102.97 and ₹ 95.64, respectively. Hyderabad had the highest petrol price among the listed cities, at ₹ 116.15. Thiruvananthapuram followed at ₹ 115.49 while its diesel price stood at ₹ 104.40. Hyderabad’s diesel price was slightly lower, at ₹ 104.23. Chandigarh had the lowest petrol and diesel prices among these cities. Petrol there cost ₹ 101.54 while diesel stood at ₹ 89.47. All these prices remained unchanged today. Bengaluru recorded petrol at ₹ 111.68 and diesel at ₹ 99.56. In Bhubaneswar, petrol cost ₹ 108.97 while diesel stood at ₹ 100.68. Jaipur recorded petrol at ₹ 113.19 and diesel at ₹ 98.25. Also Read | Centre fact-checks petrol price myths, lists 6 factors behind retail fuel rates Lucknow’s petrol price was ₹ 101.86 while diesel cost ₹ 95.36. Petrol in Patna was recorded at ₹ 113.37 and diesel at ₹ 99.36. None of these five cities recorded changes in either fuel price. Petrol exceeded ₹ 100 across all fourteen listed cities. CNG prices today CNG prices increased further across the listed locations today. Mumbai’s CNG price rose by ₹ 1 to ₹ 89.00. Chennai recorded a ₹ 2 increase, taking its price to ₹ 99.50. Bengaluru’s price increased by ₹ 1 to ₹ 98.00. Mathura’s CNG price reached ₹ 102.00 after a ₹ 2 increase. Meerut recorded the same increase, taking its price to ₹ 95.50. Also Read | Nayara Energy cuts petrol price by ₹5 per litre, diesel by ₹3 Bharatpur and Dewas each recorded CNG prices of ₹ 98.00. Both locations saw a 50 paise increase. Firozabad’s CNG price also rose by 50 paise, reaching ₹ 99.50. Sonipat recorded a ₹ 1 increase, taking its price to ₹ 95.00. New Delhi and NCR recorded unchanged CNG prices of ₹ 86.98. Rewari’s CNG price remained at ₹ 91.59, while Hyderabad’s stood at ₹ 112.00. Hyderabad had the highest CNG price among the listed locations. New Delhi and NCR shared the lowest CNG price.
